blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senators on Thursday warned heads of government agencies that their offices may suffer budget reductions if they fail to attend budget deliberations. The warning came as senators gave leeway to Philippine Sports Commission Chairperson Patrick “Pato” Gregorio, who missed the debates for the agency’s P1.9-billion proposed 2027 spending plan due to an overseas meeting with the Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA). “Those heads of agencies who were not here, we’re forewarning them now that there’s a chance na mabawasan po yung budget nila kung hindi po sila sumipot dito,” Senate Majority Leader Sen. Juan Miguel Zubiri said. […]... Keep on reading: Senators warn agency heads: No show, less budget
